scope: Nonbiological glass-grain/aqueous glycerol/air measurement review only
excluded: Pathogen, virus, toxin and biological engineering workflows
Pressure-cell fabrication, pressure escalation, emergency pressure release or hazardous equipment operating recipes
permitted_translation: Read-only data handling, contained identity/custody and qualified closed-service interfaces. Glass processing, pressurized operation and high-phi tests remain behind approved service contracts with unresolved qualification gates.
critical_caveat: Inert constituents do not make a pressurized glass system intrinsically safe; no paper value establishes a safe operating envelope.
